The offer is 'current buyer' framing: we want tour operators already selling Italy gastronomy experiences who need a boutique ground partner, so destination_overlap is strongly positive (28). source_markets is low_confidence (no direct evidence, only indirect Lithuanian HQ signals) so country is capped at 8. niche_match is high (14) because wine/truffle/culinary specialties are concrete and distinctive - operators need to align on this niche specifically. icp is 17 because the buyer type (boutique tour operator vs mass market) matters a lot for a boutique, tailor-made DMC. niche_penalty is moderate (8) since off-niche leads (polar, safari, ski-only) are clearly irrelevant.
prospect_summary: Local Vibes is a boutique Lithuania-based DMC founded by Inesa Semionova specializing in authentic gastronomic and wine-focused travel experiences in Italy - specifically Piedmont, Tuscany, and Veneto. Their offer centers on tailor-made, all-inclusive small-group trips combining wine tastings, truffle hunting, cooking classes, and farm-to-table culinary journeys. Beyond leisure, they also organize corporate workations, incentive trips, and team-building programs. The company positions itself as a connector of travelers with real people and authentic local experiences, keeping groups away from mainstream tourist circuits. Their boutique model - family-owned accommodations, exclusive venues, curated itineraries - makes them an ideal ground partner for tour operators who sell high-touch, experience-driven Italy itineraries.
